notes: This is a BETA build - it is bug prone. If you encounter any bugs go to Help > Report Bug. Please stress test as much as you can!
Model generation was rewritten for this beta. Please try Make Model on as many items as you can, especially items with props and items with multiple models (timers, cube types, etc.)

added: Model generation now runs inside BeePEE: much faster, no Java or Python needed
Generated models now show prop skins, color tints, overlays, decals, blended displacements and entity models (turrets, cubes, buttons, ...)
Icon maker: make an item's palette icon from its model (Info tab > Make Icon)
Models made in the icon maker can be picked in the Model Chooser
A warning when an instance uses files that are missing or not mounted
fixed: Props facing the wrong way, in the wrong pose or with the wrong model in generated models
Brushes misplaced, mirrored or missing in generated models
Glass, grates and invisible brushes showing up solid, black or as a checkerboard
Hidden parts (like cracked glass) and dev textures showing up in generated models
Make Model failing on very big models, or saying it worked when nothing was made
The item editor saying it saved when part of the save failed
Autopacking missing custom sounds, scripts, animations and textures
Signage designer: Export as PNG ignoring the texture size, typing shifting the canvas, and double-clicking text not editing it
Uploading a PNG for a signage doing nothing, or the icon disappearing after saving
Input delays resetting to 0 without Portal 2's FGD
Empty tiles not filling the last row of the item list
changed: New cartoon style for generated models, closer to the editor's own
Missing textures show as a purple/black checkerboard instead of being left out
Autopacking never packs base game, DLC or BEE2 files
Cleaner, smaller logs that also cover BeePEE's windows
Make Model opens the model preview when it's done
The model preview keeps its camera when switching models
Icon buttons are now Preview, Make Icon and Change Icon
